notes.title: Enemy VideoTutorial - Titan
notes.notes:
[b]Information[/b]
Titans are the basic enemy land troopers. Their hands are weapons such as blades, energy guns or even shotguns depending on their assembly.
They will face you and attack from the distance, or try to hit you with everything they have as soon as you get close to them.

[previewyoutube=O73uqMT0_pg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Tips[/b]
-Their legs are indestructible, but shoot down both knee joints to make them fall down. 
-You can destroy partially the Titans, and be aware destroying their heads may not mean finishing them.
-Some units may use armored pieces that will remove weakpoints in their body. Keep an eye on this units to search for remaining neon points in their arms, abdomen or even pelvis you can attack.
-Old titan units may be deployed from the sky, don't get in their way or they will harm you!
-Their energy blades are created using an energy propeller and you can't stop them with your blades, attack the hand instead!
-Don't keep your eyes away from knee falled Titans, even from this position they can try to shoot you!

notes.title: Enemy VideoTutorial - Vulcan
notes.notes:
[b]Information[/b]
The Vulcan is an armored unit containing and orbital cannon inside an indestructible metal shell.
In order to attack it opens the shell, extends the cannon, and performs a high intensity laser shot to the sky. A few seconds later, it falls to the floor around you decomposed in several low intensity ones.

[previewyoutube=H0WTbvdpmRg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Tips[/b]
-After the vulcan shot to the sky, the IA in your armored neo suit will mark on the floor the expected impact points to help you avoiding the fall.
-When the Vulcan extend its cannon you can shoot this point to destroy it easily.
-The Vulcan shell can't be destroyed but its energy core is placed on its bottom. Shoot this point even if the shell is closed to destroy the Vulcan and get a coreshot bonus.

notes.title: Enemy VideoTutorial - Tracer
notes.notes:
[b]Information[/b]
The Tracer is a mobility restrictor enemy unit. It uses blue laser to trace 3 trajectories around you from its wings and a few seconds later perform high speed shots following them.

[previewyoutube=ak0Jx102uMg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Tips[/b]
-The Tracer can't harm you, so you can move around freely until the instant the shots are performed.
-Shoot its wings down to disarm the tracer and it will not be able to attack you.
-Shoot to the body inner core center to get a coreshot bonus.

notes.title: Enemy VideoTutorial - Punisher
notes.notes:
[b]Information[/b]
The Punisher is a pasive enemy unit that rotates often to show you one of its two different cores.
If you use the wrong kind of energy to shoot down a core, it will turn invencible for a few seconds and will return attack.
-The green core side will trace your position and short after will perform a high speed snipping shot.
-The red core side will deploy a set of rockets that will face your direction.

[previewyoutube=qW7QMJ_rK3E;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Tips[/b]
-Take your time to shoot with the right weapon to avoid counterattacks.
-Shoot the core centers to get a coreshot bonus.
-The sniper counter will emit a beep an instant before performing the shot. Get ready to move away as soon as the tracer laser dissapear after this beep.

notes.title: Enemy VideoTutorial - Mirror
notes.notes:
[b]Information[/b]
The Mirror is an insidious enemy that uses its energy shield to repel your bullets. Depending on the hit angle it may reflect the bullets in your direction and damage you, so take care when shooting a mirror down.

[previewyoutube=OdsroZo4l6o;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Tips[/b]
-The mirror shield is disabled when its shooting you, take this chance to shoot it down.
-Also, you can destroy the 4 satellites creating the mirror shield, disabling it permanently and providing you an easy coreshot to the its main body inner core.

notes.title: Enemy VideoTutorial - Thunder
notes.notes:
Information
The Thunder unit is a enemy disposable support unit. It will place itself slowly in zones with multiple enemies and blind you if you fail the shot and don't destroy its core with a clean coreshot.

[previewyoutube=jfRV0foMKQY;full][/previewyoutube]

Tips
-The Thunder pyramids rotate often, so take your time to shot the core. 
-If you hit the pyramids and the main body collects energy to blind you, look away to avoid it.

notes.title: Enemy VideoTutorial - Comet
notes.notes:
Information
The Comet is a high maneuverability unit and will move at high speeds. Its multi-shot cannons are able to shot 3-5 bullets in a round, so special attention must be paid to deflect this attack with blades.

[previewyoutube=DN8uLxGtolo;full][/previewyoutube]

Tips
-The Comet uses the rear ailerons to impulse its body, slow down the comet movements shooting down the rear ailerons.
-Don't shoot to the comet position as it moves fast, try to predict the direction its moving to and shoot along its predicted trajectory, or wait until it faces you to get an easier coreshot.

notes.title: Enemy VideoTutorial - Floater
notes.notes:
Information
The Floater is the basic enemy unit and moves slowly around you shooting ocasionally from its linked cannon. It's slow and easy to hit.

[previewyoutube=EWCF0Lu9LKY;full][/previewyoutube]

Tips
-Destroy its cannon and you will stop him from shooting. 
-Hit the main body eye in the center and you will get a coreshot bonus.
